system.description: By marching up to any meeting of local public officials or merchants, the character may immediately ingratiate herself. By the end of the day, she has a position of great importance yet little responsibility in a government bureau or business concern. Thereafter, her existence becomes a whirl of meetings, junkets, presentations, luncheons, business dinners, parties and time with her mistress. So long as the character immerses herself in purposeless upward mobility, she avoids all important legal, bureaucratic and official scrutiny. Those attempting to deliver significant summonses are powerless without supernatural tracking, and those attempting to find her must beat her player's (Wits + Bureaucracy) roll, with the Sidereal's Essence added as automatic successes. Such work is a demanding endeavor, and the character has just seven free hours per week.
